title: Following the convention
description:
| Function | Result |
|---|---|
| `sum6(a, b, c, d, e, f)` | the total of all six arguments (they arrive in rdi, rsi, rdx, rcx, r8, r9) |
| `pick(n, a, b, c, d)` | a if n is 0, b if 1, c if 2, d if 3, otherwise 0 |
| `scale_all(array, count, factor)` | multiplies every element of an 8-byte array in place by factor, by calling `multiply(x, factor)` for each one |
| `multiply(x, y)` | x × y |
| `min_max(array, count)` | returns the smallest element in **rax** and the largest in **rdx** (count >= 1), like a C function returning a struct of two longs |

The tests also check that `rbx`, `rbp` and `r12` to `r15` are the same after each call as before.

starter.solution.asm:
sum6:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

pick:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

multiply:
        mov     rax, rdi
        imul    rax, rsi
        ret

scale_all:
        ret

min_max:
        mov     rax, [rdi]
        mov     rdx, [rdi]
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
sum6:
        lea     rax, [rdi + rsi]
        add     rax, rdx
        add     rax, rcx
        add     rax, r8
        add     rax, r9
        ret

pick:
        xor     eax, eax
        cmp     rdi, 0
        cmove   rax, rsi
        cmp     rdi, 1
        cmove   rax, rdx
        cmp     rdi, 2
        cmove   rax, rcx
        cmp     rdi, 3
        cmove   rax, r8
        ret

multiply:
        mov     rax, rdi
        imul    rax, rsi
        ret

scale_all:
        push    rbx                     ; the current element's address
        push    r12                     ; the end
        push    r13                     ; the factor
        mov     rbx, rdi
        lea     r12, [rdi + rsi*8]
        mov     r13, rdx
.loop:  cmp     rbx, r12
        jae     .done
        mov     rdi, [rbx]
        mov     rsi, r13
        call    multiply
        mov     [rbx], rax
        add     rbx, 8
        jmp     .loop
.done:  pop     r13
        pop     r12
        pop     rbx
        ret

min_max:
        mov     rax, [rdi]
        mov     rdx, rax
        mov     ecx, 1
.loop:  cmp     rcx, rsi
        jae     .done
        mov     r8, [rdi + rcx*8]
        cmp     r8, rax
        cmovl   rax, r8
        cmp     r8, rdx
        cmovg   rdx, r8
        inc     rcx
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

hints: The tests can only see `rax` of `min_max`, so they check the minimum. Still put the maximum in `rdx`: it is how a C function returns a 16-byte struct on Linux.
rules: Call multiply for each element in scale_all.

rules.message: Call multiply for each element in scale_all.
